senses.definition: A square pattern of small light and dark areas made to be read as information by a device.
senses.example: The QR code held the address of a web page.

senses.definition: The short, loud sound a duck makes.
senses.example: A quack came from behind the reeds.

senses.definition: To make the sound a duck makes.
senses.example: The ducks began to quack when they saw us.

senses.definition: To shake hard, sometimes from fear.
senses.example: A clap of thunder made the windows quake.

senses.definition: An earthquake.
senses.example: After the quake, books lay on the floor.

senses.definition: To meet the rules or do well enough to be allowed to take part.
senses.example: We need three wins to qualify for the final.

senses.definition: How good or well made something is.
senses.example: We could tell the quality of the backpack by checking its seams.

senses.definition: A feature or part of what someone or something is like.
senses.example: Being patient is a helpful quality when you are teaching.

senses.definition: How much there is of something.
senses.example: The recipe lists the quantity of flour you need.

senses.definition: An angry argument.
senses.example: Their quarrel began when both children reached for the same book.

senses.definition: To argue angrily.
senses.example: We used to quarrel about whose turn it was.

senses.definition: One of four equal parts.
senses.example: I cut the apple into four pieces and ate one quarter.

senses.definition: A coin worth twenty-five cents in the United States.
senses.example: A quarter and a dime are worth thirty-five cents.

senses.definition: To cut or divide into four parts.
senses.example: Please quarter the sandwich so we can share it.

senses.definition: The player in American football who usually gets the ball at the start of a play and passes it, hands it off, or runs with it.
senses.example: The quarterback passed to a teammate near the sideline.

senses.definition: A hard mineral. A piece cut to the right shape can vibrate at a regular rate in a clock.
senses.example: The watch has a quartz crystal to help it count time.

senses.definition: A woman who rules as a monarch, or the wife of a king.
senses.example: In the story, the queen decided to open the garden to everyone.

senses.definition: A chess piece that moves any number of open squares in a straight line in any direction.
senses.example: My queen moved diagonally across the board.

senses.definition: A female in some insect groups that lays eggs for the group.
senses.example: Worker bees feed and care for the queen.

senses.definition: Something someone asks to get an answer.
senses.example: I had a question about how the story ended.

senses.definition: To ask someone for information.
senses.example: The reporters planned to question the coach after the game.

senses.definition: To doubt something or ask whether it is right.
senses.example: When the two maps disagreed, I began to question which one was newer.

senses.definition: A line of people or things waiting their turn.
senses.example: We joined the queue for tickets.

senses.definition: To line up or put something in a list to wait its turn.
senses.example: I will queue three songs to play after this one.

senses.definition: Moving, happening, or done in a short time.
senses.example: We took a quick walk before dinner.

senses.definition: Making very little sound.
senses.example: Please use a quiet voice in the library.

senses.definition: Having little activity or movement.
senses.example: It was a quiet afternoon in the park.

senses.definition: To make or become less noisy or less active.
senses.example: The teacher raised a hand to quiet the class.

senses.definition: One of the stiff, pointed hairs of an animal such as a porcupine.
senses.example: The loose quill had a very sharp tip.

senses.definition: A warm cover made of layers of cloth sewn together.
senses.example: Grandpa tucked the quilt around my feet.

senses.definition: To sew layers of cloth together, often in a pattern.
senses.example: They learned to quilt squares of bright cloth.

senses.definition: A set of cords with knots that people in the Andes used to keep information.
senses.example: The quipu held a record of quantities.

senses.definition: To stop doing something or leave an activity or job.
senses.example: I quit the game at bedtime and saved my score.

senses.definition: Fairly or very, depending on what someone means.
senses.example: The new path was quite steep.

senses.definition: Completely or exactly.
senses.example: That is quite right.

senses.definition: A short test or a game made of questions.
senses.example: Our quiz had five questions about maps.

senses.definition: To ask someone several questions to find out what they know.
senses.example: I asked my brother to quiz me on my spelling words.

senses.definition: Words taken from something another person said or wrote.
senses.example: I copied a short quotation from the book into my report.

senses.definition: A price a person or company offers for doing a job.
senses.example: We asked for a quotation to repair the fence.

senses.definition: To repeat or write someone’s exact words.
senses.example: Please quote the sentence that gave you the clue.

senses.definition: A passage that repeats someone’s exact words.
senses.example: The sign showed a quote from the mayor’s speech.
